summary.skip_reason: Services not reachable at audit time (localhost:3001, localhost:5173)

escalations.title: Handlebars RCE via JavaScript Injection
escalations.exploit_scenario: Attacker submits malicious template syntax via any endpoint that passes user input to handlebars rendering. Arbitrary JavaScript executes in template context — full RCE on backend process.

escalations.title: Vitest UI Server Arbitrary File Read/Execution
escalations.exploit_scenario: Developer runs npm run test:watch on a shared network. Unauthenticated attacker reads .env files, source code, credentials; executes code via the server endpoint. Dev environment fully compromised.

escalations.title: Protobufjs Arbitrary Code Execution in Orchestrator
escalations.exploit_scenario: Malformed .proto files or crafted protobuf payloads sent to orchestrator trigger arbitrary code execution. Orchestrator is the foundation of the entire agent pipeline — compromise affects all teams.
escalations.fix: npm update protobufjs in platform/orchestrator/ → latest stable (≥7.5.5)

backlog.title: Specification/Implementation Namespace Divorce — 77 FRs with 0% Traceability
backlog.detail: 87 Specifications/ FRs (FR-001 to FR-069 + 10 FR-TMP-*) have 0% source traceability. Traceability enforcer never checks this directory. Creates false confidence signal when enforcer reports PASSED.
backlog.fix: Clarify whether Specifications/dev-workflow-platform.md is a demo spec or Source/ implementation spec. Update inspector.config.yml specs.dir and extend enforcer accordingly.

backlog.title: Route Handlers Call Store Directly — No Service Layer
backlog.detail: Both route files import and call workItemStore directly. Architecture rule: no direct DB/store calls from route handlers — use service layer.
backlog.fix: Extract workItemService.ts wrapping store CRUD. Route handlers call through service. Store becomes an implementation detail.

backlog.title: Traceability Enforcer Never Checks Specifications/ — False Confidence
backlog.detail: Enforcer only validates Plans/ FRs. Reports PASSED while 87 Specifications/ FRs are completely untraced.
backlog.fix: Add --specs-dir mode to enforcer, or document that enforcer only covers Plans/ FRs in CLAUDE.md.

backlog.title: Three FR Namespaces in Use — Only One Enforced at a Time
backlog.detail: FR-NNN (0% covered, never enforced), FR-WF-* (100% covered, enforced when most recent), FR-dependency-* (informally covered, loses enforcement when self-judging-workflow is more recently modified).
backlog.fix: Standardize on one namespace per active plan. Add all active plans to enforcer config.

backlog.title: FR-WF-013 (Observability) Zero Test Coverage
backlog.detail: No test file has // Verifies: FR-WF-013. Logger and metrics source files reference the FR but tests don't cover them. Observability regressions go undetected.
backlog.fix: Add tests: (a) logger emits JSON in production mode, (b) /metrics returns items_created_total, items_routed_total, items_assessed_total, items_dispatched_total. Tag // Verifies: FR-WF-013.

backlog.title: Silent Error Swallow in api/client.ts:26
backlog.detail: response.json().catch(() => ({})) silently swallows JSON parse errors. Architecture rule: never swallow errors silently.
backlog.fix: Add comment: // intentional: fallback to empty object when response body is not JSON (e.g. 502 from proxy)

backlog.title: 4 Frontend Components Have No Tests (Recently Modified)
backlog.detail: Layout.tsx, PriorityBadge.tsx, StatusBadge.tsx, TypeBadge.tsx — all modified in last 14 days, no test files.
backlog.fix: Add Vitest/RTL unit tests for each badge component. Layout.tsx should test sidebar links and responsive behavior.

backlog.title: eslint-disable Suppressing Hook Dependency Warnings in Production Code
backlog.detail: Two production files suppress react-hooks/exhaustive-deps without documented justification. Latent stale closure risk.
backlog.fix: Fix dependency arrays or add inline comment explaining why specific dependency is intentionally omitted.

backlog.title: Non-Standard Verifies Comment in DebugPortalPage.tsx
backlog.detail: // Verifies: dev-crew debug portal — embedded container-test viewer is not an FR ID. Won't be matched by enforcer.
backlog.fix: Replace with proper FR ID (e.g. FR-WF-009) or remove Verifies prefix.

backlog.title: FR-TMP-001 to FR-TMP-010 (tiered-merge-pipeline) Fully Untraced
backlog.detail: 10 requirements for E2E test generation, AI PR review, and auto-merge logic exist with zero source traceability. May be implemented in platform/ (outside Source/ scan scope).
backlog.fix: Determine which directory implements these. If platform/, add note in inspector.config.yml. If unimplemented, track as backlog gap.
